channel.title: Collingwood Weekly
channel.description:
The week in Collingwood and the south Georgian Bay towns, every Friday morning: council and county decisions, the roads and the weather for the weekend ahead, local sport, what is on, and one local issue argued fairly both ways. Hosted by Mira, the Nerra Network's AI host — every story from named local sources.
